title: Actions and links
guidance: Give functional supporting actions visible boundaries in both themes without halos. Quiet acknowledgment/return stays borderless, transparent and text-emphasized on hover. Use a distinct shared inline link color and neutral attachment tags.

Research and inspect distinct primary rose, secondary blue, quiet tertiary commands and semantic supporting colors. A dialog close X is borderless at rest; compact pagination uses a circular target and no rest border.

Latest manual correction: functional actions need visible hierarchy; reserve quiet borderless text for low-priority dismissal/return. No full-container fill hover on quiet content text controls. Add explicit solid secondary, tonal, outline and neutral utility roles alongside rose primary. Content More must have a discoverable bounded target. No new fade animations.

Human rejects the purple/violet color direction. Remove it from tonal task actions and progress badges; replacement colors remain pending human judgment. Preserve previous evidence as rejected/superseded, never accepted.

Latest human correction: make compact arrow paging hover more noticeable. Use a soft tonal circular fill plus a fine inset edge on enabled Previous/Next. This icon-navigation exception does not change quiet text-button hover.

decisions.title: One action hierarchy across themes
decisions.reason: Rose commitment; solid blue task; slate-blue supporting task; outlined safe alternative; neutral utility; transparent quiet acknowledgment/return. Quiet content controls never fill on hover. No broad glows.

decisions.title: Links use one distinct inline color
decisions.reason: Open brief and proof destinations inherit the same link system. Neutral attachment tags do not compete with blue links.

decisions.title: Offline is actionable feedback
decisions.reason: Offline Start keeps its normal pink affordance and explains the connection requirement on activation. Actual permission/lifecycle guards remain unavailable.

decisions.title: 1.9 explicit action hierarchy
decisions.reason: Use variant to select the role. Safe alternatives remain above critical confirmation on narrow screens; blocked-task useful CTA precedes quiet acknowledgment. Shared close is borderless. Legacy emphasis/context maps into the same canonical variants.

decisions.title: Discoverable compact pagination hover
decisions.reason: Shared compact+quiet recipe covers My Jobs and Reviews. Rest is transparent/borderless, targets do not shift, focus remains explicit, touch does not retain hover and reduced motion keeps static feedback.

parameters.name: Action/link roles
parameters.description: Native anchors navigate; native button/submit controls perform operations. View job fills the mobile card width.

parameters.name: Busy state
parameters.description: Dispatched task cannot submit twice. One dialog Close remains; View progress outside reopens the same background operation.

parameters.name: Canonical role paints
parameters.description: Six explicit roles with independent intent. Slate-blue task actions and blue-teal progress replace rejected purple. Quiet transparent rest/hover is a recipe invariant.

parameters.name: Compact icon hover
parameters.description: Enabled compact quiet icons use a tonal circle and inset hairline on pointer hover. Quiet text controls remain transparent.
